get.description:
Report the app version, the model endpoint, each role's model and the content status.

Always HTTP 200: the body says whether the models can be used. The model check is cached
for 30 seconds; the content status is checked on every call, so a broken file shows up
as soon as the store notices it.
The fictional bank's name, tagline, disclaimer and currency.
Every client's public card, easiest first.

post.description: Start an interview with a client. The opening line comes from the content.

get.description: The session's card, status, transcript and counters (for a page refresh).

delete.description: Delete the session and its transcript.

post.description:
Send the student's message and get the client's reply.

If a model fails, nothing is saved, so the same message can simply be sent again.
End the interview with the student's summary and 1–3 product recommendations.

The analysis and the AI coach's report, once the interview is wrapped up.

The first call can take a minute while the coach writes. Calling again with the same
language returns the same report at once. If the coach is unavailable, `report` is null
and `degraded` true: the analysis is still accurate, and calling again retries the coach.

parameters.name: lang

schema.description: The language of the coach's report.
schema.title: Lang

parameters.description: The language of the coach's report.

get.description:
Download the session: the transcript and the wrap-up, plus, once feedback exists, the
analysis, the coach's feedback and the client's full profile.

200.description: The session as a Markdown file, sent as an attachment.

AnalysisDTO.title: AnalysisDTO
AnalysisDTO.description: What code works out about the interview, without a model. Always accurate.

ClientCardDTO.title: ClientCardDTO
ClientCardDTO.description: A client's public card: all a student sees before starting the interview.

CoachReportDTO.title: CoachReportDTO
CoachReportDTO.description: The AI coach's report, in the feedback's language.

ContentStatusDTO.title: ContentStatusDTO
ContentStatusDTO.description:
Whether the content files are valid. While they aren't, the last good version is served
and `errors` lists each problem with its file and field.

EndpointDTO.title: EndpointDTO
EndpointDTO.description: The model endpoint: its host only (never the URL or key), and whether it answered.

ErrorDTO.title: ErrorDTO
ErrorDTO.description:
What went wrong. `message_key` is `errors.<code>`, for the UI to translate; `detail` is
English for developers, and never contains message text.

FactResultDTO.title: FactResultDTO
FactResultDTO.description: When a hidden fact came out, and whether a question or a product pitch brought it out.

FactUnlockDTO.title: FactUnlockDTO
FactUnlockDTO.description:
One evidence fact of a need, and the student turn that unlocked it (null if it never
came out).

FeedbackDTO.title: FeedbackDTO
FeedbackDTO.description:
Response of `POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/feedback`.

`analysis` is always present and accurate. `report` is the coach's, in `language`; it is
null, with `degraded` true, when the coach was unavailable. The only response that carries
the client's private profile (`revealed`).

HealthDTO.title: HealthDTO
HealthDTO.description:
Response of `GET /api/health`.

`down`: the endpoint can't be used. `degraded`: a role's model is missing. `hint` says
what to do about either, in English for whoever runs the app; `hint_code` names the same
problem for the UI to translate (`health.<CODE>`). `content` reports the content files
separately.

ImprovementDTO.title: ImprovementDTO
ImprovementDTO.description: A habit for the next interview, with an example.

LocalizedTextDTO.title: LocalizedTextDTO
LocalizedTextDTO.description: Text in English, and in Arabic when the content provides it (`null` otherwise).

MessageResultDTO.title: MessageResultDTO
MessageResultDTO.description: Response of `POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/messages`: the exchange and the counters.

MissedOpportunityDTO.title: MissedOpportunityDTO
MissedOpportunityDTO.description: A suitable product the student didn't recommend, and the needs it would have met.

MissedPointDTO.title: MissedPointDTO
MissedPointDTO.description: Something the student missed, with a question they could have asked.

ModelStatusDTO.title: ModelStatusDTO
ModelStatusDTO.description: One role's model and whether the endpoint offers it.

NeedResultDTO.title: NeedResultDTO
NeedResultDTO.description:
`uncovered` when the student's questions brought out every evidence fact;
`revealed_by_pitch` when every fact came out, but at least one only in reaction to a product
the student pitched; `partial` when some did; `missed` when none did. `via` is set when every
fact came out.

NeedViaDTO.title: NeedViaDTO
NeedViaDTO.description: The student turn whose answer completed a need, and what the student said in it.

PersonaDTO.title: PersonaDTO
PersonaDTO.description: Who the AI client played. The content keeps these fields in English.

ProductDTO.title: ProductDTO
ProductDTO.description: A product as students see it in the catalogue.

ProductVerdictDTO.title: ProductVerdictDTO
ProductVerdictDTO.description:
A recommended product against the answer key: `reasons` when it's unsuitable, `needs`
(the needs it meets) when it's suitable.

RevealedClientDTO.title: RevealedClientDTO
RevealedClientDTO.description: The client's private profile, shown once the interview has its feedback.

RevealedFactDTO.title: RevealedFactDTO
RevealedFactDTO.description: A hidden fact, revealed, and the student turn that unlocked it (null if it never did).

RevealedNeedDTO.title: RevealedNeedDTO
RevealedNeedDTO.description: One part of the answer key, with how far the student uncovered it.

SessionModelsDTO.title: SessionModelsDTO
SessionModelsDTO.description: The model each role uses in a session, fixed when the session is created.

SessionPublicDTO.title: SessionPublicDTO
SessionPublicDTO.description: A session as the student may see it: the card, the transcript and the counters.

SessionStatus.title: SessionStatus
SessionStatus.description: Where a session is in the flow: interview, then wrap-up, then feedback (M5).

StudentMessageDTO.title: StudentMessageDTO
StudentMessageDTO.description:
Request body of `POST /api/sessions/{session_id}/messages`.

The length limit (`max_message_chars`) is checked after control characters are removed.

SubmittedWrapUpDTO.title: SubmittedWrapUpDTO
SubmittedWrapUpDTO.description: The wrap-up as the student submitted it.

TurnDTO.title: TurnDTO
TurnDTO.description: One message in the transcript. It never says which facts a message unlocked.

UnsuitableProductDTO.title: UnsuitableProductDTO
UnsuitableProductDTO.description: A product that doesn't meet a need, and why.

VerdictReasonDTO.title: VerdictReasonDTO
VerdictReasonDTO.description: Why a product is unsuitable: for one need, or (`need_id` null) the referral note.

WentWellDTO.title: WentWellDTO
WentWellDTO.description: Something the student did well, and the student turns that show it.
